polishes.name: Defend 'til I Die (charity Lacquer
polishes.description: A soft pink crelly with pink shimmer, a variety of matte white flakes, blue metallic flakes, and a touch of silver holo micro flakes. Swatches courtesy of Color My Natural Nails, Krappy But Kute Nail Art, Playful Polish Pal, Phenomenail by Anu, Plant Nerd Broom, Jasmins Nails_.

polishes.name: Digital Gift Certificate
polishes.description: Give the gift of polish! Gift cards are delivered by email and contain instructions to redeem them at checkout. Gift cards can be used on all items in the store, and do not expire. ATTENTION - If you would like your digital gift certificate personalized, please leave a note at checkout including: - The occasion (birthday, holiday gift, etc), - Name of recipient - Name you would like displayed in the From field. If you would like us to email the digital gift certificate directly to the recipient, please also include their email. Otherwise, it will be emailed to you. Please note: Gift cards are excluded from promotional offers and codes (cannot be purchased at a discount). Gift card balances do NOT apply to shipping costs. Gift cards cannot be exchanged for a cash value.

polishes.description: Each bag may contain a mix of older or retired colours, prototypes (nothing wrong, just not had the right collection for a release), and even overpour of specialty colours that were released in boxes, collaborations, and Polish Pickup. polishes.name: The Glass Slippers
polishes.description: Back from retirement! The Glass Slippers is a white polish, packed full of duochrome shimmer, gold, pink, violet, blue and green glass effect flakies, and a smattering of tiny iridescent and silver holographic glitters. This lovely polish began as a custom request for the engagement of my sweet friend, blogger and constant supporter, Megan (of Two Lacquered Girls), called Fairy Tales Come True. It underwent a slight alteration so that hers will be completely unique, and of course the name was changed. Swatches shown are three thin coats on bare nail, two thin coats on bare nail, and a close up of two thin coats. All have one coat of top coat. Bottles are full size (15 mL/.50 ounce).
